title: No News From Boavista
theme: A round that left no trace: the Algarve's newest course kept its secrets, and the leaderboard forged across three record-strewn days at Boavista simply refused to move.
tone: Restrained and deadpan, treating a total absence of drama as the most solemn development of the week.
opening_hook: There are rounds that reshape a TEG, and there are rounds that vanish into the scorecard drawer without a whisper; Boavista, on this occasion, chose silence.

round_story.subject: The round that produced no headline act
round_story.why_it_matters: After three rounds that had already delivered a course record, a near-record gross card, and multiple blow-up holes, a round with nothing at all to report is itself a departure worth noting for a TEG that had been unusually generous with drama.
round_story.shape: The field arrives at Boavista off the back of a week stuffed with records and collapses; round four offers no comparable card, no record, no collapse worth logging; it passes into the books as the quietest eighteen of the trip.
headline_candidates: The Round That Left No Trace
A Scorecard With Nothing To Say
round_story.standfirst: After three days of records and collapses, Boavista's fourth round offered the field nothing at all to write home about.

race_story.subject: The Trophy and Green Jacket races frozen in place
race_story.why_it_matters: David Mullin's overnight command of both the TEG 2 Trophy (6, seven clear of Jon Baker's 13) and the TEG 2 Green Jacket (66, eleven clear of Stuart Neumann's 77) survives untouched, while Henry Meller's grip on the TEG 2 Wooden Spoon (39, twelve adrift of the field) likewise goes unchallenged.
race_story.shape: Round three closed with Mullin dominant in both money competitions and Meller marooned at the bottom; round four brings no reported movement in either direction; the field carries the exact same gaps forward as it left Boavista.
race_story.standfirst: David Mullin's command of both the Trophy and the Jacket survived a round that gave nobody else a chance to close the gap.

race_state_note: No round 4 results were recorded; the standings above reflect the state entering the round, unchanged since round 3 — Mullin leads the Trophy by 7 from Baker and the Jacket by 11 from Neumann, with Meller 12 clear at the foot of the Spoon table.
storyline_note: With no beats recorded for this round, both mandatory storylines are drawn from the absence of movement rather than from fresh action; no discovered storylines met the threshold.
